matches_glob
Description
This command allows the use of glob style matching, as found in
string match
,
switch -glob
,
etc.
Syntax
matches_glob
matches_glob
Implement glob style matching within a comparison
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
matches_glob
"/foo/*"
}
{
pool
foo_pool
}
else
{
pool
second_pool
}
}
